office_does: The county clerk keeps the Superior Court's records and filings and collects and pays out the fees and money the court orders.
race_blurb: Two Republicans: Clerk Charles Rhodes, elected in 2022, runs on modernizing the office and current collections; challenger Tammy Clark, a longtime law-office manager, promises to restore trust and stabilize staffing. The primary split 49% to 48%.

candidates.summary: Mason County Clerk since 2023, a licensed private investigator, Certified Fraud Examiner and Air Force veteran, running on his record in the office.
highlights: Clerk since January 2023 after defeating the appointed incumbent in 2022 [S1][S3]
Says the office upgraded technology, modernized procedures and trained staff, saving the county money [S1]
Says collections are current and delinquent accounts are pursued [S1]

experience.basis: First-term incumbent running on his record in the office.

candidates.summary: Law-office manager in Shelton for nine years, with more than 20 years in legal administration, running to restore trust and stability in the Clerk's Office.
highlights: More than 20 years of legal management, the last nine in Mason County law offices [S1]
Promises proper staffing, transparent oversight and an end to high turnover [S1]
Endorsed by retired Clerk Pat Swartos, a Democrat who held the office 1984-2012 [S4]

experience.basis: Challenger from private legal administration promising to 'restore trust' and rebuild an office she says has high turnover.
